---
title: "Alumni & Placements"
description: "Where SPIA graduate alumni went after graduating: first jobs, current positions, sectors, and locations."
---

```{r}
source("R/site.R")
source("R/theme_uga.R")
library(ggplot2)
alumni <- people |> filter(status == "Alumni")
geo <- readr::read_csv("data/geocache.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

cat_html <- function(x) cat(raw_block(x))
pos <- function(t, o) { v <- c(t, o); v <- v[!is.na(v)]; if (length(v)) paste(v, collapse = ", ") else "Not listed" }
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat_html(tagList(
  test_banner(build_mode),
  breadcrumbs(list(text = "Home", href = "index.html"), list(text = "Alumni & Placements")),
  h1(class = "page-title", "Alumni & Placements"),
  p(class = "lead-red", sprintf("%d alumni in the network, graduating from %d to %d.",
    nrow(alumni), min(alumni$grad_year), max(alumni$grad_year)))
))
```

## Where alumni work now {.section-title}

```{r}
academic <- c("Tenure Track", "Teaching-Focused", "Postdoc")
sectors <- readr::read_csv("data/vocab/sector.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)$term
counts <- alumni |>
  count(sector) |>
  right_join(tibble(sector = sectors), by = "sector") |>
  mutate(n = coalesce(n, 0L),
         group = factor(if_else(sector %in% academic, "Academic", "Outside academia"),
                        levels = c("Academic", "Outside academia")),
         sector = factor(sector, levels = rev(sectors)))
sector_alt <- paste0("Bar chart of alumni by current sector. ",
                     paste0(rev(as.character(counts$sector)), ": ", rev(counts$n), collapse = "; "), ".")
```

```{r}
#| fig-alt: !expr sector_alt
#| fig-cap: "Current sector as each alum reported it. Academic covers tenure-track, teaching-focused, and postdoc positions."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.6
#| dev: svg
ggplot(counts, aes(x = n, y = sector)) +
  geom_col(fill = UGA_RED, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.6, size = 4, colour = UGA_INK) +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12)),
                     breaks = function(l) seq(0, ceiling(l[2]), by = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Number of alumni", y = NULL) +
  theme_uga() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", vjust = 1))
```

## Map of current locations {.section-title}

```{r}
#| output: asis
on_map <- alumni |>
  left_join(geo, by = c("current_city" = "city", "current_country" = "country"))
missing <- on_map |> filter(is.na(lat))
on_map <- on_map |> filter(!is.na(lat))
if (nrow(missing) > 0) {
  cat(raw_block(p(class = "figure-note",
    sprintf("%d alum(s) are not on the map because their city is hidden or not yet in data/geocache.csv.",
            nrow(missing)))))
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Map of alumni current locations"
library(leaflet)
popup <- sprintf('<strong><a href="people/%s/index.html">%s</a></strong><br>%s<br>%s, %s',
  on_map$id, htmltools::htmlEscape(paste(on_map$first_name, on_map$last_name)),
  htmltools::htmlEscape(mapply(pos, on_map$current_title, on_map$current_org)),
  htmltools::htmlEscape(on_map$current_city), htmltools::htmlEscape(on_map$current_country))
leaflet(on_map, height = 460, width = "100%") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(~lng, ~lat, popup = popup, radius = 8, stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#FFFFFF", weight = 2, fillColor = UGA_RED, fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   label = ~paste(first_name, last_name),
                   clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(showCoverageOnHover = FALSE))
```

## Alumni by graduation year {.section-title}

```{r}
#| output: asis
years <- sort(unique(alumni$grad_year), decreasing = TRUE)
blocks <- lapply(years, function(y) {
  al <- alumni |> filter(grad_year == y) |> arrange(last_name)
  tagList(
    h3(class = "year-heading", y),
    div(class = "table-scroll", tags$table(class = "people-table",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th(scope = "col", "Name"), tags$th(scope = "col", "Program"),
        tags$th(scope = "col", "First position"), tags$th(scope = "col", "Current position"),
        tags$th(scope = "col", "Sector"))),
      tags$tbody(lapply(seq_len(nrow(al)), function(i) tags$tr(
        tags$td(tags$a(href = paste0("people/", al$id[i], "/index.html"), paste(al$first_name[i], al$last_name[i]))),
        tags$td(al$program[i]),
        tags$td(pos(al$first_placement_title[i], al$first_placement_org[i])),
        tags$td(pos(al$current_title[i], al$current_org[i])),
        tags$td(al$sector[i])
      )))
    ))
  )
})
cat(raw_block(tagList(blocks)))
```
